title: A categorical and algebro-geometric theory of localization
summary: We study cohomology classes whose restriction to the complement of a closed subset vanishes. The localisation sequence shows that their lifts to cohomology with support form a torsor under the image of the connecting morphism. We establish the behaviour of this torsor under excision, Cartesian base change, proper pushforward when compatible trace data are available, and external products, and characterise compatible local constructions in these terms.
